risks.title: New product development and introduction
risks.score_rationale: New product development and line extensions are critical for future growth. Risks include development delays, performance issues, regulatory changes, and market acceptance failures.

risks.title: Revenue growth and resource strain
risks.score_rationale: Sales growth, organic or through acquisition, may place strain on management resources and financial controls, impacting operating margins.

risks.title: Foreign exchange risks
risks.score_rationale: With operations in 176 countries and subsidiaries operating in non-USD currencies, currency rate volatility may affect consolidated sales, expenses, and results.

risks.title: Commodity and cost risks
risks.score_rationale: Specialty chemicals and aerosols represent a significant portion of costs. Oil price volatility may indirectly impact costs and gross margins.

risks.title: Interest rate risk
risks.score_rationale: With $21 million in variable rate revolving credit and a weighted average cost of short-term debt of 5.5%, a one percentage point rate increase would reduce earnings by $0.3 million.

risks.title: Acquisitions and integrations
risks.score_rationale: Past expansion through brand acquisitions increases operational complexity. Poorly managed integration risks may impact financial results.

risks.title: Divestiture of care/cleaning portfolios
risks.score_rationale: The company sold certain EIMEA segment assets in Q4 2025 and continues to assess other care/cleaning portfolios in the Americas for potential divestiture in Q1 2026.

ai_positioning.summary: WDFC does not mention artificial intelligence, machine learning, or related technologies in its 10-K report for fiscal year 2025.
